description:
Look up the full European road dangerous-goods (ADR 2025) Table A entry for a substance — all 20 columns, from class, packing group and labels through special provisions, limited/excepted quantities, packing instructions, tank codes, carriage provisions, transport category, tunnel restriction code and hazard identification number — and what each of those codes means (resolved_codes). Covers 2,939 entries across all 9 hazard classes, from UNECE ADR 2025 (ECE/TRANS/352).

Provide exactly ONE of: un_number (exact lookup — returns every packing-group variant of that UN number), search (case-insensitive partial match on the proper shipping name), or hazard_class (all entries in a class or division). un_number is normalised — "1203", "UN1203" and "un 1203" are equivalent, and normalized_input reports the correction; explosives keep their leading zero ("0004").

Behavior: read-only reference lookup; a name search or class filter is a paged list — total, truncated and next_offset, with offset and limit (at most 50 per search page, 100 per class page) — never a silently cut list. A search with no hits errors with suggestions: the closest proper shipping names in Table A ("acetne" → ACETONE, UN 1090). 28 Table A rows carry a scope remark instead of a packing group: those return packing_group null plus not_subject_to_adr (with conditions_ref, e.g. "5.5.3" for UN 1845 dry ice) or carriage_prohibited, and table_a_remark preserves the verbatim Table A text. Rate-limited: a limit error carries reset_at, the UTC time the allowance resets.

Returns: count and results[] — per entry, all 20 Table A columns: un_number, proper_shipping_name, class, classification_code, packing_group, labels, special_provisions, limited_quantity, excepted_quantity, packing_instructions, special_/mixed_packing_provisions, portable_tank_instructions/_special_provisions, tank_code, tank_special_provisions, vehicle_for_tank_carriage, carriage_packages/_bulk/_loading_unloading_handling/_operation, transport_category, tunnel_restriction_code, hazard_identification_number, variant_index/variant_count and, on scope-flagged rows, not_subject_to_adr/carriage_prohibited/conditions_ref/table_a_remark — plus resolved_codes[] beside results[]: one entry per distinct code in columns (5)–(20) across the answer, with its code, family, columns, rows (the results[] indexes that carry it), summary, ADR section and verification_status (include_codes "full" adds url, title, meaning, parameters, applies_to, references; "none" omits the list; default compact for un_number, none for search, hazard_class and un_numbers; a code's page is https://www.freightutils.com/adr/codes/{family}/{code}). The meanings are FreightUtils' paraphrases of ADR 2025, cited to section and page; verification_status says whether a person has reviewed each one (paraphrase_unreviewed until then) — under result, plus confidence, _source and citation (the FreightUtils v1 response envelope).

Editions: edition ("2025" | "2027") and as_of (YYYY-MM-DD) choose the ADR edition — edition wins, else the date picks it (ADR 2025 before 2027-01-01, ADR 2027 from then; ADR 2025 may still be applied until 2027-06-30). An answer on a named edition carries adr_edition; neither sent, the answer is ADR 2025 until 2027-01-01.

Limitations: a factual compilation of the ADR table, not legal or compliance advice; classification remains the consignor's responsibility — verify against the current UNECE ADR text.

Related: adr_lq_eq_check (checks quantities against the LQ/EQ values returned here), adr_exemption_calculator (1.1.3.6 small-load points), consignment_calculator (flags dangerous-goods lines by UN number).

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD the answer is for (default today, UTC); picks the ADR edition when edition is omitted, and is echoed in the answer and its check receipt.

edition.description: ADR edition: "2025" or "2027". Wins over as_of. Omit it and as_of picks the edition by the legal timeline: before 2027-01-01 ADR 2025; from 2027-01-01 ADR 2027 (ADR 2025 may still be applied until 2027-06-30 under 1.6.1.1 — edition "2025" answers on it until then); from 2027-07-01 ADR 2027 only. An ADR 2027 answer for a date before 2027-01-01 carries an EDITION_NOT_YET_APPLICABLE warning.

hazard_class.description: All entries in an ADR class (Table A column (3a)). Examples: "3" (flammable liquids), "6.1" (toxic), "1" (explosives — the division and compatibility group are in classification_code, e.g. "1.4S").

include_codes.description: resolved_codes beside results[] — what each Table A code means, once per answer with the rows that carry it: "compact" (code, family, columns, rows, summary, section, verification_status), "full" (adds url, title, meaning, parameters, applies_to, references) or "none". Default compact for un_number, none for search, hazard_class and un_numbers (may go beside un_numbers).

include_statements.description: true adds statements[] to every row: plain-word statements (tunnel, transport category, labels, packing, tanks, carriage) assembled from the code meanings and the 8.6.4 / 1.1.3.6.3 tables, each with basis, codes and verification_status (the lowest of the codes it draws on). Default false.

limit.description: search / hazard_class only: rows per page (default and maximum 50 for a search, 100 for a class).

offset.description: search / hazard_class only: rows to skip (default 0). The response gives total and next_offset.

search.description: Case-insensitive partial match on the proper shipping name (min 2 characters). Example: "acetone".

un_number.description: Exact UN number — 4 digits, optionally "UN"-prefixed; explosives keep their leading zero. Examples: "1203", "UN1203", "UN 1203", "0004".

un_numbers.description: Batch: up to 50 UN numbers. Send alone; answered as results[] in input order, each with its own status. One call against the daily limit, N against the Pro monthly allowance.

name: adr_lookup
